dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Krumpanion detected. Duster Mode preparation complete. Workshop's Trove preparation complete. Do you wish to open it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Open the Workshop's Trove.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Key match error. Opening failed.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Open the Workshop's Trove.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Key match successful. Opening complete.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Aino</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Aino
dialogues.text: What's the situation, Knuckle Duckle?

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Reporting. So far this week, I have detected 12 groups pass by on the road outside the workshop.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: This includes 3 groups of Treasure Hoarder Scavengers, 2 squads of Fatui, 1 small congregation of Frostmoon Scions, and 1 adventure team.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: The remaining 5 groups were all merchant caravans from the Voynich Guild. Risk index assessment: Low.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Ineffa</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Ineffa
dialogues.text: I bought the Lakkaberry Krumkake recipe you need...

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: I do not require this recipe, Multifunctional Robot for Domestic Application.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: My production date precedes yours, and my code name is superior — I do not require your assistance. I will find a recipe for Lakkaberry Krumkake that suits our master's needs myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About additional Krumkake Bolts...

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: I have retrieved the following information about additional Krumkake Bolts:

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: 1. Krumkake Bolts are the master's tokens. She will give them to those she trusts.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: 2. There may be Krumkake Bolts that the master has lost near her residence and workplace.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: 3. It is possible that the master will reward you with tokens if you help her collect trash.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: In addition to the information already provided, based on analysis of the trade lines in Nasha Town, it is possible that some tokens have found their way to the vicinity of the Kuuvahki Experimental Design Bureau.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Krumpanion has left.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Activate Duster Mode.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Dusting Module activated. Simulation target: Krumpanion!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About you...

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: I am a multipurpose armed robot for domestic application. I was created by Master Aino under the code name "Knuckle Duckle." I combine security, surveillance, storage, dusting, cleaning, and krumkake baking functionalities, among others...

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: However, after the multifunctional robot for domestic application was created, many of my functions have become obsolete.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Multifunctional robot for domestic application?

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: The multifunctional robot for domestic application, code name "Ineffa" — a word deficient in intuitive meaning.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Compared to the simple and imposing "Knuckle Duckle," "Ineffa" is more complex, hard to pronounce, confusing, and lacks emphasis. It is a name that is incapable of impressing one's opponents.

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: It is clear, then, that in a contest of code names, there can only be one winner — me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Open the Workshop's Trove.</color>

dialogues.speaker: "Knuckle Duckle"
dialogues.text: Key match successful. Opening complete.
